proposed_comments.title: Preserve app-filter selection without matching localized sentinel labels
proposed_comments.body: When preserving the app filter, search only real app entries and compare case-insensitively. Otherwise an app name that happens to match a localized sentinel label such as "All apps" or differs only by case can restore to the wrong option.

proposed_comments.title: Clear selected items before changing list selection mode to None
proposed_comments.body: After confirmed bulk delete, clear selected items before `IsSelectionMode` flips the bound list selection modes to `None`. The toggle path already preserves this ordering; the delete path should do the same to avoid touching `SelectedItems` while the lists are no longer in multiple-selection mode.

proposed_comments.title: Use singular wording when exactly one row is selected
proposed_comments.body: The button and confirmation copy currently produce "delete 1 remappings." Add singular resources and select them when the selected count is one.

proposed_comments.title: Add coverage for filtering and bulk-delete safety
proposed_comments.body: Please add automated coverage for text/modifier/app filter combinations, no-results reset, selection cancellation, and the safety guarantee that filtered-out rows cannot be deleted. These paths are stateful and destructive enough that regressions would otherwise pass the current targeted unit suite.
